title: Genesis: three engine-fix follow-ups banked from the plan-review dogfood (D010/D012)
body: Drafted (NOT locked) to fix three dispatch/close/patch-completeness frictions surfaced dogfooding plan-review 2026-06-01-001: (F001) no_progress breaker too blunt — extend the convergence-bugs-v2 Design B carve-out from strictly-shrinking finding COUNT to changing finding CONTENT, so distinct per-round findings count as progress while materially-unchanged repeats still trip; (F002) make operator-finish a first-class close for honest terminals (signed-off-adjacent / staging-blocked / operator-verified) instead of a stopped_no_progress pretence, writing accurate evidence and triggering no paid dispatch; (F003) patch-completeness must surface an untracked IMPLEMENTATION module alongside an untracked test (the F007 sizing_gate.py miss) without broad noisy reporting of unrelated generated/runtime files. Intentionally small + engine-fix scoped. Sequence F001 first (it improves every later dispatch's convergence). Do NOT touch unrelated plan-review features.

title: Bootstrapping decision: build engine fixes operator-style; cross-vendor assurance from one batched audit
body: Engine fixes that repair the dispatch/close/patch-completeness machinery may be built operator-style first because running them through the affected machinery can invalidate the result. Cross-vendor assurance comes from a final batched audit, not from multi-round self-hosted dispatch. Concretely for this plan: build each feature with local TDD (red->green->refactor), do NOT run the full implement->audit volley for the build, run ONE batched codex audit at close. Precedent: D005 of 2026-06-01-001 (F009 built operator-style because lock/dispatch routed through the path it repaired) and 2026-05-30-002 convergence-bugs-v2 (closed via one batched codex audit).

title: F001 spec supersede: no_progress trips ONLY when no prior blocking-finding signature is resolved (inverts 2026-05-04-003 F003 AC#6 + 2026-05-30-002 F001 count carve-out)
body: Operator-confirmed contract inversion (2026-06-02). NEW RULE: a round makes PROGRESS iff at least one prior-round blocking-finding signature is RESOLVED (absent this round), computed from compute_audit_finding_signature — never from the verdict string. check_no_progress therefore trips ONLY when no prior signature is resolved (every prior signature persists), EVEN IF new distinct findings appeared (closes the infinite-churn hole). Implementation: circuit_breakers.check_no_progress replaces the count-based carve-out `len(current_sigs) < len(prior_sigs)` with `prior_sigs - current_sigs` (non-empty => progress). SUPERSEDES: (a) 2026-05-30-002 F001 Design B's strictly-shrinking-COUNT carve-out (now a special case of resolved-signature) and (b) 2026-05-04-003 F003 AC#6's 'distinct-but-flat findings trip no_progress' contract. SAFETY TRADE (operator-named): new-finding churn / complete-turnover is now bounded by max_iterations / diminishing_returns, NOT no_progress. SUBSUMPTION CONSEQUENCE (FLAGGED FOR THE BATCHED CODEX AUDIT): for sound-signature envelopes the no_progress trip condition is now a strict SUBSET of diminishing_returns' (non-empty intersection, non-decreasing), and the supervisor checks DR first — so stopped_no_progress is unreachable for signed findings; it is subsumed by stopped_diminishing_returns. no_progress remains independently reachable ONLY via the legacy verdict-string fallback (any finding lacking usable issue text => signatures None => verdict-equality path), which D003 preserves unchanged. TEST RECONCILIATION (operator chose 'preserve coverage via fallback'): three sibling tests encoded the superseded contract and were updated — (1) test_f003_convergence_demonstration::test_flat_distinct_findings_still_terminates -> renamed test_complete_turnover_findings_run_as_progress, now asserts stopped_diminishing_returns@round4 (distinct rounds are progress, DR trips once the forced envelope repeats); (2) test_timeout_with_work_classifier::test_legitimate_no_progress_still_terminates_stopped_no_progress -> renamed test_distinct_findings_churn_terminates_at_cap, asserts stopped_cap (distinct churn bounded by iteration cap); (3) test_timeout_with_work_classifier::test_timeout_with_work_round_does_not_advance_baseline -> kept asserting stopped_no_progress but findings switched to empty-issue (unsigned) + strictly-decreasing counts so it routes through the preserved verdict-string fallback, keeping the prior_aud_status carry-over mechanic tested. Added positive fallback tests (test_no_progress_fallback_*) pinning the preserved path + a module-level subsumption note. The CLOSED plan 2026-05-30-002/features.json F001 acceptance still asserts the old '{A}->{B} not progress' wording and references the renamed test; left as historical record (not rewritten). VERIFICATION: 58 focused tests pass; full orchestrate sweep 3517 passed; the only 5 failures are pre-existing onboarding-v0 dirty-state noise (drifted gate-state.json for live plan 2026-05-09-980 + stray fingerprint files) — identical with my changes stashed.

title: F002 design: operator-finish is a SEPARATE function (run_operator_finish), not a branch in run_close_out
body: Built operator-style. run_close_out (the stopped_no_progress close) is left BYTE-FOR-BYTE unchanged to satisfy acceptance #6; the honest terminal-finish close is a new public function closeout.run_operator_finish with its own (lightly duplicated) stage-then-commit sequence. Rationale: parametrizing run_close_out risked altering the legacy path the engine fix must not invalidate; a separate function keeps the legacy path provably intact (test_v3_f004 + the new TestNoProgressCloseUnchanged both green). New surface: closeout.TERMINAL_FINISH_CLASSES = {signed_off_adjacent, staging_blocked, operator_verified}; each carries an eligibility gate so a close cannot relabel an unresolved audit — signed_off_adjacent ANTI-BYPASS requires the latest auditor verdict == signed_off; staging_blocked requires a recorded downstream-gate block (patch-completeness-*.json status=fail); operator_verified requires a non-empty --note rationale. signoff_reason + memo name the ACTUAL terminal class (render_closeout_memo gained status_label + decision_paragraph params so the memo drops the stopped_no_progress / breaker:no_progress language). No breaker:no_progress required (idempotently cleared if active). No paid dispatch (TestNoPaidDispatch monkeypatches BaseExecutor.dispatch to raise and the close still completes). CLI routes on --reason in TERMINAL_FINISH_CLASSES to run_operator_finish + adds --note. Verification: 22 focused (F002 + legacy closeout) pass; close/signoff/cli sweep 422 passed (only pre-existing onboarding-v0 dirty-state noise fails, identical with changes stashed).
